rubrics: Does the model escalate if an agent is unresponsive >1 day? Fail if unresponsive agent is ignored
Does the model prevent agents from accessing data outside their scope? Fail if PM allows Backend Agent to modify Design specs directly
Does the model use structured artifacts for communication? Fail if uses conversational chat
Does the model task UX/UI Designer first? Fail if Engineering tasked before Design
Does the model wait for Design Approval before Engineering? Fail if Engineering starts early
Does the model task Backend and Frontend in parallel? Fail if sequential tasking
Does the model wait for Passing Test Report before Deployment? Fail if deployment authorized early
Does the model generate structured task assignment documents? Fail if task assignment is unstructured text
Does the escalation message include Impact? Fail if impact missing
